The 'unset (null) leaves full' control survives by design. The sandbox and versus builders carry the same threading and their own cases (dropping all three builders at once measured 4 of 56 while landing this); this entry mutates the campaign branch only, so those two stay green here and are not counted.

RE-ANCHORED at issue #493, which replaced this builder's positional argument list with one `WorldForInit` object: the old `find` quoted the positional run and would now report failed-to-apply, which is the silent form of an entry that has stopped measuring anything. The MUTATION is unchanged -- the flag still stops reaching the world -- and so is the case that kills it.
